description:
The user takes the chef duty of a dinner on the chef page or the dinner page, from a dinner without a chef or from
  another chef, and resigns from it again.

elements.name: On /chef, the user takes the chef duty of a dinner without a chef and resigns from it

steps.name: a season is active
the user is on the teams
the user is signed in
team 1 cooks a dinner without a chef
the user opens /chef on the dinner
the user takes the chef duty
the user is the chef of the dinner
the user resigns from the chef duty
the dinner has no chef

elements.name: On /dinner, the user takes the chef duty of a dinner without a chef and resigns from it

steps.name: a season is active
the user is on the teams
the user is signed in
team 1 cooks a dinner without a chef
the user opens /dinner on the dinner
the user takes the chef duty
the user is the chef of the dinner
the user resigns from the chef duty
the dinner has no chef

the user opens /chef on the dinner

name: Chef duty

description:
The user who cooks on a team plans the team's dinners on the chef page. The user is on a team through their
  inhabitant.

elements.name: The chef page renders on the server and hydrates without a mismatch

steps.name: a season is active
the user is on the teams
the user is signed in
team 1 cooks a dinner
team 2 cooks a dinner
the user opens the chef page of team 1
the page hydrates without a mismatch
the user sees the chef calendar and one footer

elements.name: The user switches from the tab of team 1 to the tab of team 2

steps.name: a season is active
the user is on the teams
the user is signed in
team 1 cooks a dinner
team 2 cooks a dinner
the user opens the chef page of team 1
the user chooses the tab of team 2
the user sees the role line of a CHEF on team 2
the user sees the next cooking day of team 2

elements.name: The user switches from the tab of team 2 to the tab of team 1

steps.name: a season is active
the user is on the teams
the user is signed in
team 1 cooks a dinner
team 2 cooks a dinner
the user opens the chef page of team 2
the user chooses the tab of team 1
the user sees the role line of a CHEF on team 1
the user sees the next cooking day of team 1

steps.name: a season is active

elements.name: The user opens the chef page of a team they are not on

steps.name: a season is active
